answer: Like a fungal mycelium fusing into an immutable ridge across mineral soil, decentralized consensus resists clones through mutual stake-bonding. When an identity emerges from the chaotic nebula of unverified nodes, it must solve a cryptographic cipher validated by peer web-of-trust bonds. Sybil swarms face a superlinear attacker cost: each artificial node exponentially escalates deposit burn rates, suffocating synthetic legions.
